description:
Move windows across workspaces, reorder workspaces, and create new ones by drag-and-drop, directly from the top panel.

Workspace Bar replaces the Activities button with workspace buttons that show each workspace number and the icons of all its open windows. Every action is drag-and-drop:

- Drag a window icon onto another workspace button to move that window there.
- Drop a window icon in the gap between two workspaces to create a new workspace already containing it.
- Drag a workspace button onto another to reorder your workspaces.

Click a workspace to switch to it, click the active one or middle-click any to toggle the Activities Overview, and scroll over the bar to cycle through workspaces. The active workspace is highlighted with your system accent color.
